text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp starts today! It's a period of intense training for racers to improve their skills. However…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look at this, Trainer! It's an article about this year's Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's see… "Decisive Battle of BNW! A Whirlwind of Emotions, Spectators in Awe!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket is absorbed in the Twinkle Series magazine.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, right! Sorry, I just… you know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's exciting summer camp begins now.
